Year HDI was first introduced (1990, UNDP). UNDP is not an allowed publisher for this book and no fetched NCERT/NITI page states the year, so it is not taught from a verified quote. Gap disclosed in REPORT.md.

Which index is NOT used in HDI construction (answer: Price Index). Taught in substance: the chapter's human-development section builds development measurement on health (life expectancy), education (literacy) and income (real per capita income) indicators per NCERT Table 4.1 (keec104), so the three genuine components — and why a price index is not one of them — are covered.
